text:
alex.k: :rotating_light: seeing a spike in 5xx for /v1/generate from prod-kgw-region, looks correlated with routing change at 1799898000
maya.s: I see it too, logs show requests getting routed to model-small-1 even for enterprise accounts
alex.k: that is wrong — enterprise should be pinned to model-enterprise-v2 via header X-Redwood-Tier
jonathan_r: sounds like the header matcher in the gateway rule dropped because of the new priority comparator change
maya.s: rolling an emergency toggle: can we pin traffic for customer-tier=enterprise to route-id=enterprise-pin-2026?
priya: tl;dr plan: apply pin, monitor 10m, if OK remove the comparator change and then revert pin. rollback if errors rise
alex.k: ops-bot, kick off the playbook `route-pin-hotpatch` with params: `route=enterprise-pin-2026, scope=prod, reason=health-5xx`
ops-bot: @channel playbook started: `route-pin-hotpatch` by alex.k
ops-bot: Step 1/4 - creating temporary route with higher priority and header match `X-Redwood-Tier: enterprise` -> route-id=enterprise-pin-2026
maya.s: applied the rule. `kubectl get gateway my-gw -o yaml | grep enterprise-pin-2026` shows route present
jonathan_r: watching latency + 5xx: Grafana dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/route-health?panelId=7
maya.s: initial 1m looks stable, 5xx down from 3.2% -> 0.4%
alex.k: nice. start 10m burn-in then shift canary weighting back to default for other models
priya: note — we still need a postmortem to fix comparator change. Suggest this immediate fix be documented in runbook
maya.s: re: safety net, added `ttl: 10m` on the temporary route so it auto-expires if someone forgets
jonathan_r: also added a smoke check: `curl -H "X-Redwood-Tier: enterprise" https://gateway/prod/v1/generate -I` expecting 200
alex.k: after 10m stable, we'll create a revert PR removing the comparator change from staging -> prod, then retire the pin
priya: rollback instructions (if things degrade):

```
ops-bot: step to rollback:
1) ops-bot remove route enterprise-pin-2026
2) revert gateway comparator PR
3) restart gateway pods with `kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway` (staggered)
4) monitor 10m, escalate to SRE oncall if >1% 5xx
```

maya.s: noted and documented in the incident slack thread
ops-bot: Step 4/4 - watch window started (10m). Notifying oncall: @oncall-sre
alex.k: thanks all. after this we need a small change in console UX so PMs can toggle emergency pins without engineering intervention (with approvals)
maya.s: agreed — filing a short follow-up ticket in board: INF-1289
jonathan_r: leaving logs + tail for next 30m, will update if anything shifts
maya.s: :thumbsup:
